title: Coinbase's AI Agent Trading Volume Grows 20% Weekly

tickers.name: Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Trading conducted by automated AI agents on the Coinbase platform is expanding by about 20% every week, CEO Brian Armstrong said. Although growth is accelerating, Armstrong noted that the activity remains a small fraction of the company's total trading volume.

The growth comes as Coinbase integrates tools allowing AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude to manage trades and payments via a user's account within set limits. However, the company's agentic payment protocol, x402, saw activity drop to $372K in October from $29.11M in November of the previous year. To spur engagement, the exchange started a trading competition on Nov. 4 offering a prize pool of $2M.

selectedTweets.text:
Brian Armstrong: Coinbase's agentic trading volume is "growing something like 20% week over week right now."

He admits it's "still relatively small compared to our other trading volume."

Coinbase for Agents plugs AI agents like ChatGPT or Claude into your Coinbase account to trade and pay, inside limits you set.

Armstrong says legacy players are scared to let agents touch accounts, and he wants Coinbase to be "the most AI enabled financial account."

Payments are the slow half so far. x402, the protocol Coinbase built for agents to pay online, settled about $372K in October, down from $29.11M last November.

On Monday, Coinbase opened perps to agents for eligible traders outside the US, and its agent trading competition, with up to $2M in prizes, starts Nov 4.

FT @brian_armstrong @coinbase
